high_level_description: stc brand style, a corporate signing ceremony in front of an inspireU and InoTech branded backdrop.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A repeating backdrop wall with 'inspireU' and 'InoTech' circular logos in blue and teal, and the stc logo in white text in the top left corner.

elements.desc: Five Arab men wearing traditional white thobes and red and white checkered shemagh, at a long dark brown wooden conference table.
Two men seated signing documents while three others stand behind observing, water bottles and purple writing implements on the table.
The stc logo in the top left corner of the backdrop.
